title: New York Helicopter Tour: Ultimate Manhattan Sightseeing
description: Avoid the congestion of New York City down on the ground, and take to the sky to see Manhattan during this NYC helicopter tour. Catch sight of the Empire State Building, Statue of Liberty, Central Park, George Washington Bridge, and many other top attractions without standing in line or sitting in traffic.

reviews.usertext:
We consdiered booking a helicopter tour of NYC before our visit but decided against it as we weren't sure about the weather and with COVID, whether we'd even make it to the USA.

We saw HeliNY advertised in a leaflet in our hotel, and with the amount of helicopter flight services there are in NYC we decided to go with them.

Booking online was super easy, and were able to book in only 2 days in advance. We could fill most of our check in details in beforehand so once we arrived at the helipad it was a really easy experience.

The actual flight in the helicopter was nothing short of incredible! We had a clear blue sky day and the views were amazing. Having never done a helicopter ride before I wasn't sure what to expect, but this surpassed expectations!

The only thing I would say is that we felt a little rushed before boarding the flight and that no-one was really around to talk to and ask questions of. For example, I wanted to know whether I should wear my coat up there or not; and what I should take up with me. I ended up seeing other people arrive back and follow their lead, rather than get this information from HeliNY. And when we boarded the helicopter I was separated from my partner as I was lucky enough to be given the front seat. But it would have been nice to have been told this while in the building so we knew what was happening when outside and it was very noisy. Hence my rating of 4 stars overall.

That being said, these were very small things and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend HeliNY to others. The experience was awesome!

I took the "Ultimate tour." It was 17-20min long and went so smoothly! Check-in took maybe 15min, and we had to wait and watch a safety video. I was a single rider, which is what allowed me to sit next to the pilot. Normally, the lightest passenger (they ask your weight) will sit next to the pilot. There's that seat, 2 facing backwards, then 3 facing forwards in the last row. The pilot pointed out major landmarks and flew really smoothly :) I highly recommend this tour to anyone, as long as you don't have a fear of heights and do ok with minor turbulence.

The helicopter ride and Pilot was wonderful.
A fabulous way to see NYC yet I felt bad for the noise and air pollution as well.
I would have appreciated ALL the costs added in right at the beginning when comparing sites for transparency. For two people a facility fee was added of 70$ and a fuel charge of 10$. Thus the original price you are shown is not accurate.
I booked on line myself yet I was also charged a booking fee of 28.68$?? Not sure why.
I appreciated having a picture taken by staff while standing by the helicopter (it literally takes two seconds to do so)- but charging 45$ for it is super costly.
The view and seeing all the sites was amazing.
Just know what you are paying upfront!

Really disappointing flight. Only 13mins, when paid for 17-20 mins!! Didn’t cover all the hotspots I paid for as was informed the night before they had a flight path change but it wouldn’t compromise flight time . Well it did. I was totally underwhelmed and quite frankly felt ripped off ! We were a family of four and it cost nearly 900 pounds. Huge amount . I did complain at the end and to be fair they did offer for us to fly again. What was the point in that we wouldn’t have covered what we wanted . So time your flights people and check your hotspots you were thinking you would see .

An experience I will never forget.

I was very lucky that the weather was good, made for a lovely clear, smooth ride.

The ground staff were great, they clearly have safety at the top of their agenda. The pilot was very informative, he gave a running commentary during the flight.

Its not the cheapest thing to do in NYC, but go hard or go home, if you are never going to visit again then get this done. Its well worth it.

The experience since we arrived until we left was amazing. We were treated super nice by all the staff members. We had lockers where to leave our stuff, explanations in video and in real life by the employees. Im afraid of heights and, honestly I felt confortable even if my seat was next to the window. The trip itself was 15min but it was pretty good, the pilot gave us some cool explanations around and the flight was as quiet as it could be. They also take pics outside of the helicopter which you can buy after the trip. If I come back to NYC I’d choose them again and of course I will recommend it to all my friends who come to the city.
Thank you!

Great service, weather was bad when we arrived and we got the option to wait or to reschedule, we chose to wait. After 30 minutes the weather cleared up and we departed 8 minutes later then the original departure time.

Flight was great, the pilot did a good job flying and at the same time giving information about the city.

We did this for as a surprise for my Mums 60th Birthday. All staff were amazing and could not of done any more to make my mum feel special. They made sure they took lots of photos of us in front of the helicopter on our own personal phones. They wanted her up the front with the pilot however, there was a single man there so he had to go in the front. No big deal as my mum would prefer to share her experience all next to her two daughters. The tour itself was amazing and you won’t find close up views of the city like it. Our pilot was very informative and was polite and talked to us about the city throughout. Take off and landing was smooth and for our first heli ride felt very safe and smooth throughout. At the end the staff made an effort to bring my mum back to the helicopter and allow her to sit in the cockpit and have photos taken on our personal phone which was a lovely touch. Thank you to all at HeliNY for making this experience one to remember, it’s the little touches as well as the actual activity that make it!

I cannot recommend this company enough. I booked from the U.K. and it was easy to do and make contact with the team afterwards to confirm all was okay and booked. When we arrived, we were greeted by friendly and helpful staff who whisked us inside and got us ready for the flight.

There were photos taken outside with the helicopter on the ground with the city in the background and these are available for purchase after the flight.

The flight was amazing and the pilot was knowledgable although he occasionally got his left and right mixed up…. I’m the same, to be honest it was funny!

We had the full flight time shown on the website, not a minute cut off!

The staff were awesome, this was a brilliant experience from start to finish!

Oh and another bonus…. When you buy the digital version of your photos…. If you have an iPhone, they run Apple Macs so it gets airdropped straight into your camera roll!! Winner!

Thanks HeliNY! ❤️🤍💙

Very short trip 15 min from departure to landing, I bought “ The Ultimate” package by paying more but there wasn’t any difference. I end up paying $280, they even Didn’t allow me to take a pic with the helicopter.
They took one low quality pic me standing beside the helicopter and would charge $45 to give you a copy!

This tour was well worth the cost. The pre flight organisation was seamless, and the actual flight was incredible. We saw NYC in a whole new way, that was more than we could have imagined. The pilot also pointed out key highlights in the landscape and ensured all passengers had opportunity to view from good angles. Staff also happily took photos on your phone before you boarded the helicopter, plus took professional ones you could purchase (but weren’t pushy about it at all). The initial and subsequent email reminders with specific information about check in time, online waivers and getting the Google maps directions right, made everything so easy. Highly recommend this tour and the company.

Worth every penny! The pilot was exceptional, the staff kind and kept us briefed and prepared. The views were breathtaking! With full side windows you experience all the city from above - and the pilot points out key areas and buildings as you go. All was clean, COVID safe and truly the most wonderful experience I’ve ever had

The whole experience from start to finish was professional and slick - AND fun!

We arrived at the allotted time and the greeting experience and safety aspect was well done, and our guide to the Helicopter did everything to keep us safe.

Our pilot (Tim) was excellent, pointing out the landmarks of New York with a little history and a lot of humour. The whole flight was perfect, made better by perfect New York weather!

I’d definitely do this again and would definitely use these guys again!

The tour in itself was simply amazing! Very smooth starting and landing. And the view was breathtaking. It was my first time flying a helicopter and I‘ll have to do it again because the experience and feeling was that amazing.
But it was kind of a rip of that they take a couple of pictures of you in front of the helicopter and for 40$ you can get the digital version of JUST ONE of the pictures…

To be honest it was a little disappointing. It was meant for my Sons 18th but weight distribution meant that he sat backwards so didn’t feel he has a great view. Also very short. Paid for ultimate but not sure we saw that much. I have helicopter rides before in Dubai and New York many years ago and this didn’t live up to the excitement and not sure it was worth the money

Did this trip on my 50th birthday and was so memorable. My 4th time on an nyc helicopter and my sons first…it blew his mind.

I’ve used liberty in the past but this was the best trip by far and cannot recommend these guys enough.

Our pilot was David and we felt super safe and he was really informative.

We flew around Manhattan from top to bottom and over the Statue of Liberty.

Yes it’s a few quid but this really is a once in a lifetime experience.

Truly stunning. Thanks Guys.

Booked the Ultimate tour a few months up front which was a very easy procedure. The day of the flight was cloudy but still very good weather an visibility was top notch. The flight itself was performed by a very friendly and knowledgeable pilot. Overall an excellent experience and definitely recommend taking such a tour!

We had an excellent experience! Due to bad weatherforcast, we asked te reschedule, which was no problem at all.
The welcome was friendly and after a short safetymovie, we were ready to go. Friendly pilot too, who gave some explaining. There is so much to see that it is probably better to know the city already because then it's easyer to recognize the highlights already (that's what we did).
We took a private ultimate tour (because we're 5), although the heli had only place for 5 guests so that was a bit sour... One tip: in the helicopter it is extremely warm so jackets and scarves are totally unnecessary ;-)
Thanks to the team!

Great experience. Great location. Very efficient process!
This whole experience was great from start to finish. It was a present for my 16 year old nephew’s birthday. They checked our temperatures outside, made sure we were wearing a mask. Took us inside, I signed a straightforward release. They put packed life vest around our wais, we sat down for maybe 5 minutes and then they called us up to line up. Our tour was to be at 10am (they asked us to get there at 930) and we were in a helicopter by 950. The helicopter was excellent. We had 5 people total and every person had a window seat with their configuration style. They driver was knowledgeable and friendly. We booked a 20 minute tour and saw all of Manhattan!

I did the ultimate tour with HeliNY and highly recommend it. I am visiting NYC from London as a solo traveller, and the whole team at HeliNY made me feel so comfortable from start to finish. Booking was easy and reasonably priced.

On arrival, each member of staff I encountered was friendly and helpful. The flight itself was immense, going up and down the Hudson. This meant whichever side you sat, you got a great view of everything. The experience was totally unforgettable, and my pilot (I have forgotten everyone’s name!) was personable, answered any questions I had, and pointed out all the key sites.

Another special shout-out to the lady who was doing the photos at the end. The whole team are the best and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this experience if you’re visiting NYC.

The service and flight were excellent. The aerial view of statue of liberty was breathtaking. Never to be missed. The Washington bridge, the empire state building must be seen from the heli to admire the full scenery of it. Overall excellent tour

Trip was amazing from start to finish. Security, safety, professionalism, and of course amazing tour / views of Manhattan! Greeted at the front door, security checked, seamless check in, watched a safety video, escorted to the beautiful and clean aircraft. Assigned seats were given based on weights and then you're in the air! Windows were abundant and clean easy to get great photos. Up and down the Hudson River for us and my two kids (13 & 10) couldn't stop smiling and taking videos and photos. Highly recommend taking this adventure with HeilNY and getting this wonderful experience you and your friends/family will never forget!

We took the Ultimate Tour for our honeymoon on April 19th. The crew was very professional and treated us very well. We got there earlier and we went on the ride right away, even before our scheduled time, which was great for us. The pilot shared a lot of facts about the city while we were flying. It was a windy day in NY, however that didn't impact the flight. Me and my wife can't wait to go again.

We wanted to experience New York from a different perspective, and decided to book a ultimate helicopter tour, from the moment we booked, the commercial exchanges were very good, helpful, kind and very informative.
When we arrived for the tour, the first impression is a bit disorganized, but then when in the building, a team of friendly professional take over.
The helicopter, the pilot, the comfort were remarkable, we felt safe, and the tour was very informative, we benefited from a beautiful and clear sky. We enjoyed the experience a lot

If you never been on a helicopter, New York is definitely the city to have your first helicopter ride. And of all available agencies, I can definitely say that you will not go wrong with HeliNY. The price is reasonable, the helicopter is maintained very well, the pilot is friendly and cute. I had the time of my life and will not hesitate to do it again!

The helicopter flight was magical, pilot was very knowledgable..the whole experience was amazing , to see the whole city from air is just wonderful. Highly recommended this tour and this company to anyone. A lovely photograph for keepsake at the end of the tour is a must, thanks Ali for your kindness and patience 😊

Everything was organized on a high level. All the safety protocols regarding Covid-19 were followed 100%.
The helicopter was super clean like it was a brand new. The staff was incredibly professional, polite and friendly. And the most important the tour was an incredible experience. I’d highly recommend to use HeliNY as a provider of a helicopter tour along Manhattan.

Your russian fan.

Thank you!

Great experience ! Flying over NY is fantastic ! We chose the Deluxe tour.
The helicopter is comfortable and the pilot provides commentaries on the views. Great way to enjoy the flight !
Du to the weather, we had to postpone our flight for one day and everything was done by phone in 5 minutes! Real pros

From the moment that we arrived at location we were treated professionally and everything was explained to us. The whole flying experience was spectacular with amazing sights and a very comfortable ride. The pilot kept us aware of key sites as we made our way along the river side. 😀

Not really one to complain but what an absolute waste of money. The pilot was as exciting as watching paint dry and seated backward made the whole thing an absolute waste of time and money bordering on impossible to take a pic. Huge disappointment and a big 👎👎. Even my daughter said “Dad that was a disappointment”.

Amazing experience! The staff was very friendly and hospitable. The place was very structured and in order. Every staff member was in communication with each other and very organized. I would def recommend it to my friends and family. Also the pilot was a very good driver and the ride was very stable and very enjoyable!

This trip was amazing! It was very well organized and extremely safe. I was a little nervous on the lead up because I can suffer with situational anxiety! However, at no point was I anxious or nervous.

Our pilot was very informative and the ride was so smooth. We had a great day for weather so the visibility was just perfect. It was so much fun and we got to see the sights of the city from above. It was breathtaking.

I would totally recommend this trip to anyone visiting NYC, it was worth every penny!

If you are unsure whether to do it, DO IT!

We took the Ultimate Manhattan tour during our trip to New York.
It was a great experience, we really enjoyed it and it even exceeded our expectations. The views were great, breathtaking (even on a cloudy day), and much better than from any observation desk or view platform.
The crew was very friendly and professional. We would definitely do it again!

Very professional organization, from scheduling, providing updates, arrival, and through the flight. The ground crew kept things running smoothly and made sure we were ready, answering any of our questions. The pilot (Sawyer) was professional, polite and seemed very experienced. He made sure we were comfortable with our flight and provided great information along the way.

It was an EXCELLENT trip
As soon as we walked in we were very well received by the staff.
The pilot was a great professional we felt safe at all times and he gave us a great tour.
The day was beautiful, we had an amazing time !
I higly recommend.

Absolutely amazing experience. I booked this tour 6 months in advance based on reviews and I'm over the moon with the service received. The staff were amazing, all questions answered, very accomodating and we asked to be seated together and they were more than happy to do this. The Helicopter ride itself was amazing, the whole experience didn't feel rushed and I felt as though we got the full experience. 100% worth every penny.

The staff was so professional and really made everything so easy for us. The tour was breathtaking, we’ve been to the city multiple times but seeing it from the air was beautiful. Totally would recommend and can’t wait to come back!

This was a birthday surprise and it was fantastic! The staff was friendly and everyone was welcoming. It was exciting and we were lucky to have a gorgeous day with amazing views over the city.

Covid precautions were taken seriously, and the helicopter was spotless. The pilot was really nice and had a lot of knowledge and info.

We loved that the tour company was located in Manhattan, so you didn't have to make a huge effort to go out of state for something similiar. We are locals but I would definitely recommend tourists do this!

We did the helicopter trip as a special treat for my sons 21st. What a great experience from beginning to end. Every single member of the team excelled themselves and were so friendly and professional. My son even got to sit up front with the pilot which just made it even more special. A huge thanks to all the team, we loved our trip!

A truly unforgettable experience. First, the heliport is in Manhattan, unlike most companies which is why we chose to fly with heliNY. And they did not disappoint us. Everything was perfect: Great communication regarding the arrangements before the flight. Then when we arrived everything was well organized and the staff was great, very friendly and professional. The flight over the city was incredible and very interesting thanks to the comments of the pilot.
I couldn’t have thought of a better experience!

The people were really nice and it wss amazing! I was sitting next to the pilot so that was really cool. First my flight was on Saturday, but they rescheduled it to Monday. But Monday is it was foggy so they couldn't fly. In the end my flight was on Tuesday and the weather was perfect. Also they responded really fast on my e-mails.

My experience at HeliNY was absolutely incredible! The helicopter flight was one of the best experiences of my life and left me speechless. Our pilot Magnus was personable, informative and funny! What really made the experience even better was the incredible crew that works there. Brian and Roberto provided top class customer service and safety instructions. They went above and beyond to make this a day I would never forget.

Big shout out to Brian for making my request to sit up front next to our pilot Magnus come to fruition. And a big thank you to Roberto for remembering as I walked out the door to leave that I didn't have my hat on and left it inside. If you're looking for a helicopter adventure in NYC look no further then HeliNY!

Terrific experience! Simply wow, flying so high an looking at the skyline. Very nice pilot who answered every question. Very smooth procedure getting on the heli with good safety measures. We felt safe all the time. Spectactular views from the Statue of Liberty and Manhattan up the Hudson River. We will definitely do it again next time we are in NYC.

Adrian the pilot and the helicopter was great and super fun.

I will say there was a lack of organization and communication in the lobby waiting to fly.
A couple of times, different employees looked at me like I should know what I'm supposed to do or what they're asking me.
I had to ask "excuse me?" A few times.

My 15 year old daughter and I took the tour. It was a Christmas present from my husband. The service was fantastic, very efficient and the pilot was very nice and pointed out all the main landmarks. Would really recommend it.

From the moment I arrived at the Manhattan Pier 6 complex I was treated like a VIP. Amazing and detailed, the team toke fantastic scare to ensure I had what I needed and was safe and comfortable. The flight staff was outstanding and Sawyer our pilot was super!!! Thanks so much for a memorable birthday tour!! Cheers!

I loved everything! They also waited for me when I ran 2 minutes late which I loved. It was just unfortunate that we weren't allowed to take our own pictures with the helicopter - my pictures wouldn't appear on their camera but they did give me an opportunity to go take another picture so I think it was an issue with their camera. Overall, had a good time and would highly recommend. I sat next to the pilot after requesting that for my birthday so thanks to the team for setting that up before hand!

From check in to disembarking the helicopter, everything was brilliant. Staff so friendly and helpful. The views, well they speak for themselves. The location is really easy to reach also from our hotel near Times Square which was an added bonus. I’d highly recommend!

We had good weather and took a trip up the Hudson to see Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty. The pilot did a great job and was very entertaining. The flight was smooth and the highlight of the whole trip. Highly recommend it.

Surprise gift for my 30th birthday.
Had an amazing experience, staff are lovely and friendly.
Was a little nervous at first but staff reassured me, felt safe the whole time and enjoyed every minute of our flight.

HeliNY was the perfect way to see NYC! Roberto was awesome getting us prepared for the flight and Magnus, our pilot called out landmarks during thr tour. It was the best view of my life. This is a must do!
Great way to see the city. Staff was very professional and courteous. They went the extra mile to make us comfortable. I’m glad I went on this tour, it was a once in a lifetime way to see The City.

I was nervous as I booked this but friends persuaded me to do it and oh boy am I glad I did!!

Great set up, put us completely at ease and our pilot, Bill, was lovely. Informative and friendly - couldn't have asked for more. We were blessed with a good day which helped but I would urge anyone to put their brave pants on and take an unforgettable trip.

Would definitely reccommend!

First you wait outside. Sitting on ground. Then you wait inside. And wait. And wait. And wait. About an hour or more. Felt like a herd of cattle. Helicopter tour ok. Nothing special. Pilot excused himself several times from remarking on what we were seeing as he was talking with other pilots. Ho hum.

Amazing way to see NYC. Highly recommended to all. Not being from NYC was a little nervous on getting down and finding heliport.

This is my one suggestion, be more descriptive on how early to arrive and what to expect.

Walking in, staff was amazing. Took great care of us and extremely efficient. The pilot extremely knowledgeable and great guy to talk to during the flight.

Communication prior to booking was great. Organisation on the day was slick. The helicopter was clean and comfortable and the pilot really friendly and knowledgeable. Great experience for our friends 50th birthday! 👍 Thank you.

Excellent tour. From start to finish staff was polite and professional. Took my nephew to NY for an early birthday getaway, he loved it. Had to cancel 1 member of our tour for illness and refund was processed immediately. Will do again!!!

I'm still amazed. Having the opportunity to see NYC from the sky is breathtaking
Very easy to get to the docks, get checked in and secured
They are very conscious about H&S, queues don't last long and staff are very attentive and friendly. Our pilot was a pleasure to talk to. He made the trip interesting for sure
I can't recommend it enough, is a must done in NYC!

Amazing experience, nice view, good time, good weather, in top security trip. However, the pilot was speaking so fast that it was difficult to understand what he was saying for non english natives. Beeing 5 instead of six could add a confort plus expérience also. Thanks.

If you’re on the fence about taking a tour, do it! It’s the most incredible way to see the city. Whether you live here or not, you’ll absolutely love getting to see Manhattan from a bird’s eye view! Also, the staff here is incredibly accommodating! I got updates on my trip before we even got to the helipad, and they were so friendly during our visit. Thank you HeliNY!

It was much better that I have imaged. The ground crew was delightful and made my girlfriend experience for here birthday so great.. Big shout goes to our pilot (Tim I believe). It was a great flight with a very funny and enjoyable commentary.

I booked an Ultimate Helicopter flight with HELINY and was very disappointed. I booked this as a gift for my husband as it was our 20th Wedding Anniversary. I unfortunately was sat in the middle on the back row and had extremely limited view, my headphones were also not working so was unable to hear any commentary. Admittedly when I mentioned afterwards how disappointed I was they offered to fly me again (but not with my husband so was pointless really). Such a lot of money for a really poor experience!

First off, ranked this only a 4, because there were two of us as a couple on the flight. They seat you by weight, so you don't get to choose your seat.

One of us was at the front alright hand side of the helicopter, the other was the back left, behind the pilot.

As the pilot flew us up the river with Manhattan on the right, he was describing everything in Manhattan, on the right. The only person on the whole flight with a poor view was the one sat behind the pilot on the left hand side.

As a result, one of us didn't see the yankee stadium, or Concorde or some of the more funky shaped buildings in NYC.

Clearly the concept of helicopter flights work and they are amazing buy bear in mind that if you get unlucky and you are behind the pilot you will miss some sights.

That said, if you are going to fly, push the budget to get the longest flight that you can afford, the longer the better for a great experience.

I’m still totally overwhelmed with my whole experience I had with heliNY on 11/05/2018. Definitely the BEST helicopter tour company, HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
Dreams do come true and heliNY certainly made this happen for me. One wish I’ve had, is that I’ve always wanted to take a flight in a helicopter, in New York to take in the stunning sights of New York from the air. This amazing company HeliNY offer tours that include various sights and flying times. Their leaflets are exciting to read and gave great info of what they offer. I looked down their selections and I knew as soon as I saw their Deluxe Tour included the Verrazano Narrows Bridge, undoubtedly this was the tour my heart was wishing to do. I booked on it a good few days in advance then longed for the day and time to come. On the day after the safety briefing, it was time to let HeliNY begin to unfold my dreams.
Wowwwww boys you really did unfold my dreams so beautifully and you hit the heights for me! The exciting feeling I felt as we lifted up from the ‘H’ then turned flying higher and higher to begin this Deluxe Tour was out of this world. The pilot was brilliant and superb also very informative along with clearly pointing out things in enough time so I knew exactly where to look below. Flying over the Verrazano Narrows Bridge was TOTALLY AWESOME. I’ve sailed under it many times and now I’ve flown over it, is unbelievable; how my heart was so excited. I felt an extremely lucky girl as I was privileged to take my flight next to the pilot, something that was far out of my wildest dream, and yet there I was sat next to him flying in the helicopter not just fulfilling my dream in every way but it was being taken far and beyond anything I could have ever wished for. Thank you heaps and heaps HeliNY team you were ALL AMAZING. I’ll remember my experience for EVER.
A quick note for readers: Something I would like to add, I’m a disabled lady and NEVER once did my pilot or any HeliNY team make it a problem I am so grateful to you all. THANK YOU so VERY, VERY much for making my whole experience TOTALLY
AWESOME.

Our helicopter ride was out of this world. It had to get prosponed due to weather so they gave us an additional 10 minute flight time on the day we were rebooked. It was busy when we arrived but we were immediately sat down and made a fuss off like everyone else in there. The service was great and the actual flight itself was informative and breathtaking. I would recommend anyone coming to nyc that this is a must.

We booked onto the Ultimate tour, slightly longer than the standard tour, but worth the small price difference. We booked ahead and got our confirmation for our first choice time. We were slightly nervous with the weather, but luckily we had a high cloud ceiling and beneath it was a perfectly clear day. We arrived and were welcomed by a few different staff, all of whom were professional whilst being funny and relaxing. We had a short (20 minute) wait and then boarded. They take professional photos which were $25 to take home on a USB. The flight was amazing, the views were perfect, the pilot was knowledgeable and pointed out the main sights, all whilst keeping us safe. I would really recommend this to anyone visiting NYC that wants to see the sights. This was probably the best thing that we did whilst in NYC!

The whole experience was amazing. We arrived late & flustered for our pre-flight check in. All the staff were welcoming & friendly, & our late arrival was not deemed problematic. The flight itself was truly magical - Admittedly I had the best seat - sitting in the front next to the door (front & side views!) The only downside the weather had changed so grey skies as opposed to photo ideal of perfect blue - but obviously not the fault of NYHeli Tours!!! The actual flight - route passed the Statue of Liberty & up the Hudson river with glorious views of Manhattan- was perfect. The helicopter itself was a fab looking piece of machinery - cool, black & beautiful. What a fab day. Would so recommend this trip.

We booked this trip expecting it to be a maximum of 6 passengers. We are a family of four and shared the helicopter with a further 8 people. We received no safety briefing and the staff were not particularly friendly, until it came to purchasing a photo at 40 dollars. The headphones were so poor that you could barely hear the commentary from the pilot. We have since found out that this is because they have removed the batteries from the noise cancelling part of the headphones. Great way to see NY but overall a very disappointing and overpriced experience.

Wanted to do something different this trip to NYC - found the helicopter tour and it was amazing. It is short, about 15min - and it is expensive - but it is such a great way to see the city. The booking agent, and the trip confirmation says to be there 45min early - which we were; however, the other groups showed up 15min beforehand and had no issue. No need to be there super early, to sit and wait. Had an absolute blast doing this!

We went today with New York Helicopter Tours on Tue 4th Sept on a beautiful clear day. Birthday present. On arrival it was pleasant enough on arrival at office but you are treated a bit like a number. A few more smiles would not have been amiss. You are only allowed phones and cameras on flight. They give you a lockable locker for bags etc. Very tight security which is good. They squeeze 6 passengers to a flight which is one too many as one poor passenger did not have a window seat and was squeezed in between us. If it was me I would have refused to go. It is not a cheap 20 minute flight. Captain gave a good commentary but on arrival no one took photos and I don't think they really cared as they had their money. Great flight though and amazing to see Manhattan from the air.
it was very impressive. lots of emotions and adrenaline. I always dreamed of see New York from a height. if helikocter, in my opinion, in this city is best do it) dreams come true))))

I surprised my husband for his birthday with a tour over the holiday week and it was truly the BEST birthday surprise.
We have been New York City residents for 12 years and it was such a unique perspective from which to see our city!
In addition, everyone was highly professional. We loved our pilot who offered fun and interesting information she shared about the landmarks we saw. We even learned a few things!
A big THANK YOU to the entire HeliNY team for helping make our experience one we will never forget.

I have wanted to experience NYC by air for the longest time and as a treat to myself, I decided to include a helicopter ride during my last visit to the city. It was incredible! I arrived early (a bit too keen) but the staff were kind enough to let me go on an earlier ride. The pilot was very informative and the views are amazing! This is a must do attraction! The people are all very nice and welcoming. You have to follow their rules and do not get an attitude with them and you will have an enjoyable experience. Be patient! They will get you in and started as soon as possible. They have to get things ready so you have a great experience. I saw some impatient people and they were treated accordingly. You have to watch a safety video before going up. Your seat in the helicopter will be based on your weight. They decide where you will sit. You do not decide. All seats are good. Again, don't argue with them and you will have an enjoyable experience. Do not take pictures of yourself in front of the helicopter outside. They will do this for you. If you do, you will be yelled at. Follow their instructions at all times! I loved this trip. I got some great pictures of the city, and I will always remember it. Here is one piece of advice. When you are finished with your trip up in the sky they are going to offer you your picture in front of the helicopter for $25.00 or your picture in front of the helicopter and some professional pictures that they have taken for $35.00. DO NOT BUY THE 35.00 PACKAGE!! It was a total waste of money. They will give you the pictures on a flash drive and they were the absolute stupidest pictures. All pictures had the helicopter in them. One of the pictures even had a bride and groom in them. Seriously? I was expecting professional pictures of the skyline. If you want to pay the 25.00 for your picture in front of the helicopter, fine. It is expensive but may be worth it to some. Do not buy the 35.00 package. You will be extremely disappointed.

We flew from Manhattan heliport which was very easy to get to - forget spending half a day to get to NJ.

Overall, this was a really great experience - I’m sure it would be improved by hiring the whole helicopter yourself but I’m not made of money!

Breathtaking. An absolute must for anyone visiting NYC if you can stretch to it. Views are genuinely outstanding and there's no way you'll get anything close to them elsewhere. Helicopters look brand new, are incredibly comfortable and the pilots give great information. Couldn't recommend more.

One Note: As I arrived, I could not present proof of purchase via email. I was emailed a flight reservation but I could not simply download this to my phone. I copied the email to MS-Word & converted it to a .pdf. It would be helpful if the staff simply verified the passengers Last Name via proof of a driver's license, etc. No staff member gave me a problem- but this is a suggestion.
There are no COVID Vaccinations to present to the staff; however, you need to sign a waiver.

The entire flight was supreme! A few weeks prior, I was hesitant; yet, I am glad I changed my mind! The staff/crew/pilot were all very courteous. As the passengers enter the Downtown Manhattan Heliport- they may store their bags/belongings in a locker & watch a 3-1/2-minute safety video.

No pun intended, after takeoff, this 20-25 minute voyage flies by! Time elapses quickly above the Hudson River. I went when the winds were close to 30-mph. It was awesome to see One World Observatory, Empire State Building, Chrysler Building, the Hudson Piers, the New Jersey Side, & Yankee Stadium. This was money well-spent! Do It!
Amazing experience. Entire staff was great! Communication was prompt and thorough throughout the entre process
It was very fun to see Manhattan with an aerial view! I liked that I got my photo taken to remember the moment.
This was an amazing tour with great views of Manhattan, the Statue of Liberty, and surrounding areas. Great experience.
Our helicopter ride was great, the pilote was awesome, felt safe and the overall experience was perfect!
Very good experience. The problem is that they didn’t take a lot of pictures at the beginning even if we asked them to. (Just 2-3 more instead of 1-2).
It's an exceptional experience and shockingly mellow in terms of noise, confusion, etc. I was nervous for one of my kids but they both had a great time!
It was a wonderful experience. I would definitely do it again. I will be recommending this to all my family and friends.
Such a fun time! The folks at HELINY were amazing start to finish. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the city and gave us a great flight. I would highly recommend!!
Great experience. Great service. Highly recommended. Will definitely do it again myself. Definitely a 10 out of 10!

Such a great experience and very helpful and friendly staff! Also, their customer service phone works perfectly and I always had my questions answered when I was calling the, couple of times before my tour.

I have lived in Manhattan since 1991 and I have never seen this city like this before! It was completely worth every. Single. Penny. My friend and I did the private Ultimate Tour and the amount of time in air was perfect. Take off and landing a dream and the entire staff were friendly and very pleasant. One thing I would give them as a piece of advice, you don't ask a woman out loud in the lobby in front of her friends and/ or partner what her weight is!! Luckily I wasn't embarrassed with my friend that went with me, but seriously?? who does that? Thanks though- GO BOOK YOUR TRIP TODAY!!

A helicopter ride is absolutely one of the best things I have done in NYC. But for the amount that I spent on it for two people (close to 600$) and for the total time we were in the air (18 minutes) I don't think I would pay for it again. It was just a trip down the Hudson, turn around and go back. No actual going over the sky line which I thought we were doing. We were also crammed into a helicopter with 4 other people (6 total in a tiny copter) not ideal.

I went on a helicopter tour with HeliNY on the 2nd of February 2019 while on a trip to New York. Both my partner and I were very excited; I haven't been on a helicopter before so we were hoping for a great experience. When we got there, we sat down and waited for our flight time after going through the general procedures of putting bags away, putting life jackets on etc. While sat there, we saw a couple come in (who ended up being on our flight) and we witnessed one of them take out a wad of cash out of his pocket ($150/200 ish?) and handed it over to one of the employees in hand attempting to be subtle. We joked and said they probably paid to get the best seats on the flight. We then went through the safety briefing which said that seats were decided by weight and the lightest people go in the front and this is done for safety reasons. The employees then went on to further reiterate this but, to our surprise, that couple are the people who are chosen to sit in the front. Now, of course, they may have weighed less than us, however seeing as my partner is clinically underweight and the couple were both taller than both of us, there is little to no chance that they both weighed less than my partner. Afterwards, the rest of the tour was aimed at them. We were sat on the left so as we went through the tour, Manhattan was on the right and New Jersey was on the left at first until we turned around. The pilot said there was nothing to see on New Jersey's side and so continued to point out the Manhattan points of interest but assured us we'll see it on the way back. However, on the way back, all he pointed out was then areas of interest on New Jersey's side and nothing from Manhattan’s, evidently having conveniently suddenly remembered that New Jersey was interesting on the way back. The most frustrating part of this whole experience was that if said couple had paid this company or one of the others at the helicopter site directly rather than giving the employees cash in hand, from roughly the amount they seemed to have given, they would have gotten their own private helicopter flight. Also, the fact that the employees took the bribe shows me that either the safety video is a lie and people aren't seated according to weight or the employees were willing to put the safety of everyone within the helicopter at risk. I was appalled by this behaviour from all members of the staff and it left a really sour taste in our mouths throughout the entire experience. It ended up feeling like a complete waste of time and money and frankly gave a really bad impression of New York in general.

Don't miss out on the heliride with Helikopter Flight Services when you visit New York, this is the must do ultimate experience!!

Helicopter Flight Services runs a very safe and professional operation - and I can tell because I'm in the aviation business myself. You will find the staff to be very helpful and professional, and the aircraft are modern, comfortable and clean. Another cool thing is that you get to use those top notch Bose noise cancelling headsets on the flight, they are very comfortable and quiet, so crystal clear communication is assured. The pilot is also a skilled guide, and in between you get to hear him talk to Air Traffic Control and other aircraft in the area. Very nice, and also very reassuring for those that feel a little uneasy about being up in the air!

If visiting NYC during low season you are really lucky, cause then you can schedule your flight in the late afternoon, when it gets dark, and Manhattan is at its most spectacular.

Just perfect, a memory for lifetime!!
Absolutely awesome !!!!! A fantastic way to see manhatten & the like. Memories you'll remember for a lifetime. Book it now !!!!!
First class service, amusing and knowledgeable pilot, amazing views from nice and comfi helicopter with huge windows. Could not recommend more.

Wow, such a nice helicopter flight! It was really nice seeing the city from the top, you are able to see everything from the Statue of Liberty, One World Trade Center, Midtown, Central Park and Yankee Stadium, even twice cause it's a round trip. It was really nice and worth it! The pilot was very good and the trip was outstanding. Really recommend it!
Fabulous views over Manhattan skyline informative pilot a great way to see New York a memorable fun time
Excellent experience run by friendly and professional staff. Pilot was great and views were incredible! Well worth doing.
If you set aside the price of this, there is no better way to see New York. The pilot gave us interesting information through the whole trip.

Exactly as advertised and good value for money. A terrific 20 minute experience if you're in New York and want great views of Manhattan from a large chopper above the East River. Got some great shots. Staff are very professional and efficient with a strong focus on customer safety. Don't wear a baseball cap or anything that can fly off - lockers are provided for loose items. Highly recommended as a memorable and exciting New York experience. Do it!
Defiantly something everyone should do when in New York. Quite expensive, but the amazing views will make you forget the price. Tip: sunset is defiantly the best time to go
